_doc: Buffs and debuffs ride on Farhold's statuses (farhold/data/skills.json `statuses`, applied with skills.js applyStatus). This file adds what Oathwild needs on top: the stacking rule, which kinds of cure remove what (`dispel`), the icon id the client draws, and a few Oathwild-only rows. Rows here are laid over Farhold's in memory (js/rules/engine.js). js/rules/auras.js is the one reader. Default dispel by element: poison -> poison, shadow -> curse, physical -> none (bleeds stop on their own or with a bandage), anything else -> magic. Default icon: `aura_<id>`.

stacking._doc: One of each status per body (Farhold keys statuses by kind). A second caster's copy: the stronger one stays and the timer takes the longer of the two; statuses with a stack limit (poison from a dart, frostbite) add a stack instead. Buffs from your own spells never stack with themselves.

knockdown.name: Knocked down
knockdown._doc: Thrown to the ground by a blow (a spell row's knock.down; data/combat.json knock): no moving, attacking or casting until it gets up.
